fields.description: The page the hospitality app opens on.

fields.label: Tape Chart Days
fields.description: Number of days the tape chart shows at once (7 to 62).

fields.label: Board Refresh Interval (Seconds)
fields.description: How often the front-desk and housekeeping boards refresh. 0 turns auto-refresh off; otherwise at least 15.

fields.label: Hold Expiry (Minutes)
fields.description: How long an unconfirmed hold keeps its rooms before they are released.

fields.label: Max Advance Booking (Days)
fields.description: How far ahead a stay can start.

fields.label: Allow Walk-ins
fields.description: Allow stays that are created and checked in on the same day without a prior reservation.

fields.label: Booking Sources
fields.description: Where bookings come from, offered on the booking desk. These are ERPNext UTM Sources, so revenue by source shows in ERPNext reports. Leave empty to offer every UTM Source.

fields.label: Enable Preference Suggestions
fields.description: Show suggestions from a returning guest's past stays and appointments, with evidence.

fields.label: Minimum Occurrences for a Suggestion
fields.description: A suggestion is shown only after it has happened at least this many times.

fields.label: Enable Preference-aware Room Ranking
fields.description: Rank available rooms against the guest's preferences when assigning a room. Staff still confirm the choice.

fields.label: ID Document Retention (Days)
fields.description: Days after checkout before stored guest ID details are cleared. Leave empty or 0 to keep them.

fields.label: Allow Room Charge for Services
fields.description: Let in-house guests charge spa and other appointments to their room folio. When off, appointments are paid as they are today.
